# Kermit Floor

> Kermit Floor is a manufacturer of SPC (stone polymer composite) flooring, wall panels, and skirting boards for residential and commercial interiors. Headquartered with its main factory in Çayırova, Kocaeli, Türkiye, with an additional factory in Chișinău, Moldova and a store in Bucharest, Romania. The site is bilingual: English (no prefix) and Turkish (/tr prefix).

## Product Collections: SPC Flooring

- [Elite SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-elite-collection): Quick-ship premium SPC flooring decors
- [Elegance SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-elegance-collection): Refined SPC flooring decors for modern interiors
- [Sky SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-sky-collection): Versatile decors for residential and commercial projects
- [Mosaic SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-mosaic-collection): Patterned, stone-inspired SPC flooring designs
- [Travertine SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-travertine-collection): Travertine-inspired SPC flooring
- [Natural SPC Parquet Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-parquet-natural-collection): Best-selling natural oak SPC planks
- [Stone SPC Parquet Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-parquet-stone-collection): Stone- and marble-look SPC flooring
- [Full Natural Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/full-natural-collection): Full range of wood-look SPC flooring, 110+ colors

## Product Lines: Wall Panels

- [SPC Wall Panels](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-wall-panels): Waterproof, durable, easy-to-install wall panels
- [SPC 3D Wall Panels – Model A](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-3d-wall-panels-model-a): Fluted 3D panels with geometric textures
- [SPC 3D Wall Panels – Model B](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-3d-wall-panels-model-b): 3D panels with elegant wave patterns

## Product Lines: SPC Skirting Boards

- [SPC Skirting Boards](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-skirting-boards): Hub for all 8 skirting lines — 60–140 mm heights, flexible edges
- [Optima 90mm Skirting Board](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-skirting-boards/optima-90-mm-skirting-board)
- [Optima 60mm Skirting Board](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-skirting-boards/optima-60-mm-skirting-board)
- [Solid 80mm Skirting Board](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-skirting-boards/solid-80-mm-skirting-board)
- [Berlin 100mm Skirting Board](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-skirting-boards/berlin-100-mm-skirting-board)
- [Elite 100mm Skirting Board](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-skirting-boards/elite-100-mm-skirting-board)
- [Moderna 100mm Skirting Board](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-skirting-boards/moderna-100-mm-skirting-board)
- [X-Line 100mm Skirting Board](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-skirting-boards/x-line-100-mm-skirting-board)
- [Alpha 140mm Skirting Board](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-skirting-boards/alpha-140-mm-skirting-board)
